micah: Quick question before I open a TF PR — I'm changing how we set ExternalSecret lease/renewal TTLs in the infra module so Vault leases align with k8s secret refresh. Two quick checks: 1) do we have a single externalsecrets service account per cluster/namespace or some teams created custom SAs? 2) will this require adjustments in Vault policies (max_lease_ttl) for the existing roles?

emily: We generally create a shared `externalsecrets-sa` per namespace via the chart, but a few apps spun up their own. :point_up: you can check with `kubectl get sa -n <ns> | grep externalsecrets` to find anomalies. For Vault, yes — the role's `max_lease_ttl` needs to be >= controller TTL so it can renew. Our typical policy snippets look like:
```hcl
path "secret/data/apps/*" {
  capabilities = ["read", "list"]
  max_lease_ttl = "24h"
}
```
If you reduce controller TTLs below that, it's fine; increasing TTLs requires policy change.

jared: Which terraform module are you touching? infra-k8s/externalsecrets module? Two other things: make sure the controller sync interval (`--sync-period`) is compatible with shorter TTLs, and add a migration plan for existing ExternalSecrets so they don't get stuck. Also watch for kube2iam / IRSA bindings if you're in EKS.

anika: Also double-check the helm values we ship in `charts/externalsecrets/values.yaml` — we inject SA name + env for lease TTL via `controller.env`. Example override snippet for the chart:
```yaml
controller:
  extraEnv:
    - name: VAULT_LEASE_TTL
      value: "1h"
```
If you change the default in TF, update the chart defaults and the README.

deploy-bot: deploy notice: externalsecrets controller helm chart v1.4.2 was deployed to prod on 2025-11-02 04:12 UTC — current controller image: `external-secrets/controller:v0.10.1`.

micah: Thanks — I'll: 1) scan namespaces for custom SAs and add detections in the module, 2) update the TF variable `externalsecret_lease_seconds` with a sensible default (3600), 3) add a changelog entry mentioning Vault policy `max_lease_ttl` implications, and 4) include a script to reconcile existing ExternalSecrets. Opening PR in a few.

emily: For the reconcile step, run something like:
```bash
kubectl get externalsecret --all-namespaces -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.refreshInterval==null) | .metadata.namespace + "/" + .metadata.name'
```
Then follow up with `kubectl annotate` to force refresh or patch the resource.

jared: Ping me on the PR and I'll review the RBAC/IRSA bits. Also add a short rollout plan: canary one namespace -> monitor sec-rotation logs -> roll out cluster-wide.

micah: Will do. PR later today, tagging @jared @emily. :thumbsup:
